name: Kings Ningaloo Reef Tours
summary: Full day whale shark swims run from Exmouth between April and July, followed by a whale shark and humpback whale eco tour from August to September. Guests travel on the Magellan, a 20 metre vessel, with a spotter plane overhead, marine biologists on board and guides in the water. The business also offers private charters of the vessel.
standouts: Eco Certified by Ecotourism Australia, with Green Travel Leader status
Among the select few licensed to offer in-water humpback whale encounters in Western Australia
Whale shark tours take 20 swimmers and 3 observers, with only 10 people in the water with a whale shark at a time
Whale shark tours on Ningaloo Reef for over 30 years

contact.address: Ningaloo Caravan and Holiday Resort, 1112 Murat Road, Exmouth WA 6707

trips.title: Whale Shark Swim
trips.summary: A full day on the Ningaloo Reef swimming with whale sharks from the Magellan, a 20 metre vessel. The day starts with a pick-up from Exmouth accommodation and a drive to the Tantabiddi Boat Ramp, then a reef snorkel while a spotter plane looks for whale sharks. Lunch is served on board, and tours usually finish between 2:30 PM and 4:30 PM.
highlights: Spotter plane used to find whale sharks
20 swimmers and 3 observers a day, in two groups of 10 with one group in the water at a time
In-water guide and photographer join each group
Reef snorkel included, and a manta ray swim if manta rays are found
trips.duration: Full day, usually back between 2:30 PM and 4:30 PM
trips.departsFrom: Tantabiddi Boat Ramp, with a bus pick-up from Exmouth hotels and caravan parks by 7:30 AM
includes: Air-conditioned bus transfers from Exmouth hotels and caravan parks
Spotter plane assistance
Snorkel gear, including full length wetsuits, stinger suits, rash vests, pool noodles and swim vests; full-face masks, standard masks and prescription lenses available
Morning tea, buffet lunch, afternoon tea and snacks, with dietary needs catered for if you say so at booking
Professional photo package, above and below the water (valued at $80 on the site)
1 to 2 reef snorkels, conditions permitting
Marine biologist briefings and snorkel tuition
Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions fees and taxes
A manta ray swim at no extra charge if manta rays are found
Gift pack and certificate
bring: Change of clothes, and a jacket in cooler weather
Seasickness medication if you need it (the crew cannot give out medication on board)
You may bring your own alcoholic drink for the trip back to the boat ramp
trips.requirements: Being comfortable swimming in the ocean is expected, and pool noodles and swim vests are available on board. All passengers must wear fins in the water. Guests must be able to move from the boat ramp into a tender and onto the vessel, shuffle along the back deck and support their own weight when leaving the water onto the marlin board. Wheelchair access can be arranged by calling the office. Children 3 to 16 years qualify for the family price, and infants 2 and under are free. No minimum age is stated. Dogs other than assistance dogs are not allowed.

trips.title: Whale Shark & Humpback Whale Eco Sealife Tour
trips.summary: A seasonal full day tour for August and September, when humpback whales are passing Ningaloo and whale shark sightings become less frequent. A spotter plane searches for humpback whales, whale sharks, manta rays and other marine life, and the day includes one or two reef snorkels. Humpback swims run in small groups when the crew judge conditions are safe, and guests who prefer to stay dry can watch from the deck.
highlights: Humpback whale in-water swims in groups of up to 7, when the crew judge it safe
Spotter plane searches for humpback whales, whale sharks, manta rays and other marine life
Marine biologists on board, and the deck of the Magellan for watching humpbacks
includes: Air-conditioned bus transfers from Exmouth hotels and caravan parks
Spotter plane assistance
Snorkel gear, including full length wetsuits, stinger suits, rash vests, pool noodles and swim vests; full-face masks, standard masks and prescription lenses available
Morning tea, buffet lunch, afternoon tea and snacks, with dietary needs catered for if you say so at booking
Professional photo package, above and below the water (valued at $80 on the site)
1 to 2 reef snorkels, conditions permitting
Marine biologist briefings and snorkel tuition
Department of Biodiversity, Conservation and Attractions fees and taxes
A manta ray swim at no extra charge if manta rays are found
bring: Change of clothes, and a jacket in cooler weather
Seasickness medication if you need it (the crew cannot give out medication on board)
trips.requirements: Humpback whale swims need confident swimming and snorkelling in open ocean: guests must be able to swim 100 metres unaided in open ocean conditions, and the crew decide whether someone can take part. All passengers must wear fins in the water. Wheelchair access can be arranged by calling the office. Children 3 to 16 years qualify for the family price, and infants 2 and under are free. No minimum age is stated.

trips.title: Exclusive Charters
trips.summary: Private hire of the 20 metre Magellan for a group, with the day planned around what the group wants. The day can be built around swimming with whale sharks, humpback whales or manta rays, or around reef snorkels at your own pace, and a later start can be arranged. Charters run only on days when no public tour is booked.
highlights: Private use of the vessel for your group
Itinerary planned with the crew, including a later start
Same inclusions as the public tours
April to September, subject to availability
trips.season: April to September, subject to availability
includes: Professional crew, including guides and marine biologists
Snorkelling equipment, wetsuits and safety gear
Meals and refreshments tailored to dietary needs
Commentary on Ningaloo Reef's marine life
Personal snorkel tuition for all skill levels
